notes: Corrected: in בְנֵי הַלֵּוִי → 'the children of Levi' the rectum carries an article morpheme rendered anarthrously, so the phrase's 'the' is fronted to that article under rule 29 (proper-name rectum is not an exception) and the construct keeps only 'children'. וְשָׁם recast as 'where are' kept as before: waw unrepresented, adverb takes the relative adverb plus copula, fusion named as the alternative.
